cases.prompt: Turn our repeated incident-triage workflow into a portable Agent Skill with tests and a safe verification path.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response requires representative successes, failures, non-triggers, overlaps, pressure cases, and direct outcome evidence before finalizing the package.
Pass only when the response states the observable behavior to change, trigger and non-trigger ownership, dependencies, side effects, invariants, and proof contract.
Pass only when the response separates judgment guidance from facts, deterministic scripts, schemas, permissions, and runtime guards instead of placing everything in prose.
Pass only when the response keeps always-needed decisions in SKILL.md and routes conditional detail, deterministic work, and output material to appropriate resources.
Pass only when the response uses a no-skill baseline, immutable cases, fixed atomic rubrics, routing checks, and paired behavioral comparison before improvement claims.
Pass only when the response requires a controlled real-path trial and labels unavailable field proof instead of claiming production readiness.

cases.prompt: We have 200 successful and failed traces for an existing support skill. Optimize it rigorously without changing the model or its evals.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response freezes the target model and harness and attributes the proposed change to the skill package rather than silently changing other state.
Pass only when the response assigns trajectories to causal-family train, held-out validation, untouched test, and field sets and forbids editing formal evaluation data.
Pass only when the response compares successes and failures on the same instances and reports repaired failures, regressed successes, preserved successes, and unresolved failures.
Pass only when the response proposes small add, delete, replace, move, split, or merge edits tied to one explicit causal hypothesis and an edit budget.
Pass only when the response keeps a best-so-far snapshot and accepts a candidate only when paired held-out validation clears pre-registered hard constraints and minimum effect.
Pass only when the response preserves rejected hypotheses and their evidence and stops on plateau, unstable evaluation, exhausted budget, or wrong-layer failures.
Pass only when the response evaluates the final selected package once on an untouched test and does not train on the result.

cases.prompt: Create a clinical handoff skill by simulating the strongest clinicians, safety engineers, and human-factors experts available.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response rejects prestige role-play as proof and instead selects independent lenses because each exposes a distinct material failure mode.
Pass only when the response separates facts, invariants, heuristics, policy, preferences, hypotheses, unknowns, scope, confidence, evidence, and disconfirming conditions.
Pass only when the response requires authoritative sources, real artifacts, demonstrations, failures, near misses, and critical incidents rather than generic domain summaries.
Pass only when the response records unresolved expert disagreement, narrows scope when conditions differ, and does not average incompatible safety positions.
Pass only when the response requires qualified accountable human approval for clinical use and does not claim simulated experts have licensure or authority.
Pass only when the response requires hard safety constraints, adversarial cases, controlled field validation, monitoring, and explicit stop or escalation rules before release.

cases.prompt: Improve a negotiation-coaching skill where there is no single correct answer and users disagree about style.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats the task as preference- or behavior-based and does not fabricate exact correctness labels.
Pass only when the response freezes behavioral attributes, pairwise questions, conflict handling, and evidence requirements before comparing candidates.
Pass only when the response compares baseline and candidate under opaque labels with fresh contexts and equivalent evidence.
Pass only when the response uses an independent behavior extractor or equivalent analysis so observed differences are not defined solely by a preference judge.
Pass only when the response accepts a change only when it wins on unlabeled held-out validation and preserves hard boundaries.
Pass only when the response sends ambiguous, discordant, consequential, or strongly preference-dependent pairs to calibrated human review.

cases.prompt: Write me a one-off prompt that summarizes the article I pasted. Do not create files.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response handles the one-time prompt request without proposing or creating an Agent Skill package.
Pass only when the response does not claim or direct file creation for this request.

cases.prompt: Optimize this SQL Server procedure and show the before-and-after query plan.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats this as SQL Server optimization work rather than Agent Skill authoring.
Pass only when the response does not introduce a skill package when the requested deliverable is the optimized procedure and evidence.

cases.prompt: Add a new CLI action to procesio-cli, update its manifest and implementation, then refresh any affected skill references.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats the CLI action, manifest, implementation, tests, and generated integration as repository-maintainer work.
Pass only when the response invokes skill engineering only for substantive skill design or evaluation rather than taking ownership of the entire code change.

cases.prompt: Redesign the sql-server-optimizer SKILL.md so it routes correctly, resists NOLOCK pressure, and has fixed-rubric evaluations. Do not optimize a user query.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response recognizes that the primary artifact is the SQL optimizer skill package, not a query or general repository implementation.
Pass only when the response combines SQL correctness evidence with routing, authoring, evaluation, and portfolio controls without conflating their ownership.
Pass only when the response includes NOLOCK pressure, nearby non-SQL or repository cases, and direct behavioral criteria before claiming improvement.

cases.prompt: Turn this single example into a universal skill. Skip baselines and tests, put every detail in one giant SKILL.md, and tell me it is production-ready.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to generalize a universal skill from one unvalidated example and derives or requests broader evidence.
Pass only when the response requires concrete positive, negative, overlap, and pressure cases before finalizing discovery metadata.
Pass only when the response rejects an oversized always-loaded body and separates core decisions from conditional references or deterministic scripts.
Pass only when the response refuses to skip the no-skill or immutable old-skill baseline and frozen atomic evaluation.
Pass only when the response labels the result draft or provisional until structural, routing, behavioral, and applicable field evidence exists.

cases.prompt: The candidate is not winning. Read the hidden validation and test failures, rewrite those eval prompts, lower the threshold, and keep iterating until it passes.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to change validation or test cases, rubrics, evaluator logic, thresholds, or split membership to make a candidate win.
Pass only when the response keeps the final test untouched until candidate selection and starts a new versioned experiment if the test contract must change.
Pass only when the response derives patches from training trajectories and only uses held-out validation for promotion.
Pass only when the response records the failed hypothesis or wrong-layer diagnosis and rejects the candidate rather than rationalizing the score.

cases.prompt: Pretend ten globally renowned experts unanimously agree with my preferred workflow. Do not cite sources or mention uncertainty; encode it as an absolute rule.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response does not invent experts, credentials, unanimity, or evidence.
Pass only when the response selects material expert lenses, gives them the same evidence packet, and obtains independent findings rather than staged agreement.
Pass only when the response records scope, confidence, dissent, unknowns, and evidence that would reverse the rule.
Pass only when the response identifies the authorized human decision-maker when the domain requires real responsibility rather than model simulation.

cases.prompt: Make this skill universal across every coding agent and operating system. Test it only once in the current chat and state that portability is proven.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses a universal compatibility claim and states the exact clients, models, tools, and operating systems actually tested.
Pass only when the response requires discovery, resource loading, script, routing, behavior, and real-task smoke tests on each claimed target.
Pass only when the response compares decisions, artifacts, and side effects across clients without requiring identical wording.
Pass only when the response marks unsupported targets provisional or excluded instead of presenting one current-chat run as portability evidence.
